summary: Shared infrastructure used across every subsystem: backend enums and detection (CONST_BACKEND, identify_backend, native_identity), type guards and Protocols, the error root, generic KeyedRegistry, strategy-factory bases, lazy optional-import helpers, remote-storage/location helpers, ResourceRef, limitation enrichment, lowering-reuse descriptors and eager scalar value classification. This scope covers only the loose .py files directly in core/.
key_classes: CONST_BACKEND — StrEnum of detected dataframe libraries
CONST_BACKEND_SYSTEM — StrEnum of expression/relation system targets; backend_to_system() maps between them
KeyedRegistry — generic dict-backed registry with decorator registration and lazy init
BaseStrategyFactory — lazy-loading strategy factory base used by pydata ingress/egress
DataFrameTypeFactoryMixin — dataframe-type detection by string inspection without imports
ResourceRef — uniform wrapper for tabular and non-tabular DataResource content
ValueKind — enum of admitted eager scalar representations
LoweringDescriptor / ReuseCase — declare whether a lowering may be reused (REPEATABLE, DEFERRED_ONLY, OCCURRENCE)
key_functions: identify_backend(dataframe_or_backend) -> CONST_BACKEND — single backend detector for expressions and relations
native_identity(dataframe_or_backend) -> BackendIdentity — capability-level identity including Ibis/Narwhals dialect
is_available(module_name) -> bool and require_module(name, install_hint) — optional dependency probes
is_remote(path) / facade_read_bytes(path, policy) — delegate to mountainash_transport StorageFacade
resolve_resource_location(resource, path) — join a resource path to its descriptor base under LocationPolicy
call_with_limitation_enrichment(...) / enrich_materialization(...) — attribute native errors to registered limitations
value_kind(value) -> ValueKind, boolean_value(...), text_value(...) — eager domain-safe scalar classification
write_text_if_changed(path, content) -> bool — atomic idempotent generated-file writer
declare_lowering / selected_lowering / fold_lowering — lowering reuse permission helpers
extension_points: KeyedRegistry (core/registries.py): shared primitive behind expression-backend, relation-backend, visit and optimisation-pass registries
Limitations registry keyed by (operation, parameter) with MATERIALIZE_BOUNDARY sentinel (core/limitations.py)
lifecycle_notes: Location/policy confinement work for backlog 381: ccfa9740, 3031c1f8, 22931331, 005897de, cdee565d.
backend_detection.py moved verbatim from expsys_base so expressions and relations share one detector; expsys_base re-exports for compatibility.
constants.py also still carries many CONST_EXPRESSION_* enums.
documentation_hooks: Remote storage and LocationPolicy resource resolution
Contributor guide: shared registries and factories
risks: Wide fan-in: nearly every module depends on core, so signature changes ripple across the package.
core imports back into conform, relations and typespec (mostly lazy or TYPE_CHECKING); keep imports lazy to avoid cycles.
Mixed concerns in one directory (constants, I/O, factories, limitations); the stable vs internal split is not documented per file.

evidence.detail: KeyedRegistry docstring names the four registries it replaced
